dialogues.speaker: Tepano
dialogues.text: I heard someone mention that some Condessence Crystals had emerged out of nowhere. Our first thought was that it might be Ley Line troubles, so a whole bunch of people rushed over to check things out.

dialogues.speaker: Tepano
dialogues.text: As it turned out, it was just some ordinary ore. Not that having a place to replenish resources is a bad thing, of course. If you wanna have a look, it should be in... this direction.
